strings.home.identityLede: 165 yashicilelwe njengokuhlanganisa oku-10 okwenziwe ngokwezifiso, enokuhlangana kwezinhlobo eziningi zezinto zokusebenza, ezinokuhlangana ngesiseko esodwa lemininingwane.
strings.home.principleLede: Isiseko esiqondile esithiyo sisa umlinganiselo, usesho, umphendulo, umkhawulo, umugqa, i-archive, ufundiso, ukushicilela, i-AI, i-API, nokufunda komculo. Akukho ukudideka. Akukho ukuguqulwa.

strings.home.depositBody: Izincwadi ezingu-6 zokulondolozisa ezinhlelelwe (i-Master Control 000, i-Governance 007, i-Editorial Constitution 008, i-Source & Citation Policy 009, i-Master Blueprint, i-System Architecture) manje ziyadluliselwa ziyabonakala ngokuphelele kwidawo yezincwadi. I-Charter yomhleli wokuqala nezincwadingezo ezingezizo ziyafumaneka — leli gama liza kube kusukela kwizincwadingezi ezisezinhlobo.
strings.sec.explore.title: Konke amagama, umhlalo wolwazi
strings.sec.explore.lede: Sondela abantu, inkampani, indawo, imibono, amagama, amathoni, nemiklamo. Konke okubonakala kuyenza ukulinganiswa kwevithiki nokusetshenziswa kwakho.
strings.sec.library.title: Izincwadi, amagqabuko & amakhophi
strings.sec.library.lede: I-Umsakazo iyasiza izincwadi namakhophi nge-metadata engafani nokushicilela: ukubhala, ukukhonjiswa, inkampani edla ngayo, namathoni. Akukho konke okufika kwisishayamithi ngaphandle komagama.
strings.sec.archive.title: Izincwadi, ulwazi lwesizwe & amagama e-landelo
strings.sec.archive.lede: I-Archive idla ngokuyigcina amagama edijithali njengelandelo: ivunyelwe, iyachaziwe, futhi idluliselwe. Amagama esizwe asongwayo — ukushusha kudlula, akakasusa.
strings.sec.research.title: Amathoni, imiklamo & ibhibhiyoloji
strings.sec.research.lede: Indawo yefundiso ihlukanisa okuthiwa kususwe okuthiwa kususwe. Imiklamo iseka imiklamo; amathoni asusa amathoni; akukho konke okungaphezulu kwevithiki.
strings.sec.academy.title: Ukuhlanganisa okusekelwe kumatoni, akukho okusekelwe kumandla
strings.sec.academy.lede: I-Academy izodlisa amasiko, amasiko, nemiklamo — konke ukufunda kushicilela amagama ayo. Isiseko sashicilelwa lapha: isistemi semagama yasebusha ishayiwe.
strings.sec.media.title: Ukubonisa, ushicilela, idokumenti & ukudlula
strings.sec.media.lede: I-registry yemedia idlisa imibono, ukubhala, namagama edijithali — konke okubonakala kudluliselwa kuzo, akakadlulanga ngokusemthethweni.
strings.sec.trust.title: 165 ithini — isakhiwo sokuhlonishwa
strings.sec.trust.lede: 165 ayikhiphi ukuba ihlonishwe ngenhloso. Iyikhiphi ukuba ichaziwe. Konke amagama ayenza ukulinganiswa kwevithiki, isimo sokuchaziwe, amathoni, namakhopho akayo.
strings.sec.about.title: Inkampani, eshicilelwe
strings.sec.about.lede: 165 yini, yishicilelwe yini, ibhiyizwe yini, namandla okulondolozisa, namandla okuhlonishwa amagama.
strings.sec.documents.title: Indawo yezincwadi se-165
strings.sec.documents.lede: Izincwadi ezingu-6 zokulondolozisa ezisekela konke se-165.web.id — i-Master Control, i-Master Blueprint, i-System Architecture, i-Governance, i-Editorial Constitution, ne-Source & Citation Policy — manje ziyavuliwe ukuba abantu abanakele bafunde ngokuphelele.
strings.sec.seo.title: Amagama amakhulu umshini wesesho
strings.sec.seo.lede: Ukulinganisa kwamagama angu-1,200+ angaphakathi kwesikhathi eside leTQN Qodiriah Naqsabandiyah. Konke igama lidla ngemininingwane edlalene, umgomo wesicelo, amagama ahlala, umkhawulo wokuchaziwe. Yashicilelwe ngesikhathi esinye — iyachaziwe, ishicilelwe, idluliselwa.
strings.sec.contribute.title: Ukuhlanganisa amagama — ngesishayamithi, ngaphandle kwesishayamithi
strings.sec.contribute.lede: Abantu abaningi bangathumela ulwazi, amathoni, ukubhala, inkampani, amagqabuko, ulwazi lwesizwe, namashusha. Ukuhlanganisa akukho ukushicilela: konke okuthumelwa kuchazwa ngaphambi kokufika kwisishayamithi.
strings.docs.searchPlaceholder: Sesha kuzo zonke izincwadi ezingu-6... ngokuthi, sanad, founder, Tier A
strings.docs.noResults: Akukho igama elinaniwe lelihlobo "{q}". Zama igama elisha — ngokuthi, "sanad", "evidence", "founder".
strings.docs.verbatimBody: Oku uthi bheka lapha kuyigama eliqondile lelicwadi — akukho ukushicilela okungaphelele. Konke licwadi lidla ngakho okuqukethwe kuyo, isikhathi, isimo sokwenziwe; izinketho zenzeka kuphela ngokulondolozisa, akukho ukushicilela ngokusemthethweni.
strings.docs.closingNote: Lezi zicwadi ziyamathoni okuqala konke ukubonakala kwesistemi: isakhiwo somuntu, isistemi yokulinganiswa kwe-A-F, amalungelo e-sanad, namandla okulondolozisa konke okunye okubonakala kuyizalela lapha. Unesishusha okanye ukwandisa okuqukethwe kumagama? Thumela ngokushicilela — konke okuthumelwa kuchazwa, akakashicilelwa ngokusemthethweni.
strings.lang.title: Ulimi
strings.lang.search: Sesha amagama... (ulwazi lomuntu, isiNgesi, isiNgisi, code)
strings.lang.hint: Ulimi oluqala lwe-165 isiNgesi. {curated} amagama aqukethwe ngokuphelele, {ai} amagama ahunyushwe ngumshini we-AI, konke okunye amagama asukelelwe — isiseko sayo sizohlola isiNgesi. Okuqukethwe kwamagama okuqukethwe kuyisikhathi esifushane.
